capability.description: Calls the Open Notify ISS-now endpoint with no inputs or query parameters. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Live International Space Station latitude/longitude retrieval; not orbital prediction, trajectory planning, or astronaut status.

constraint.io_signature: Input: none. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and ISS position result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET http://api.open-notify.org/iss-now.json with no params
position is live at request time and not a historical track or forecast
wrapper does not locally truncate or parse the response
service availability and coordinate freshness are external; no auth, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing current ISS timestamp and latitude/longitude, URL, and HTTP status.
